meta_title: AI Explorer Course | Start Your AI Learning Journey
meta_desc: The AI Explorer track builds core skills in artificial intelligence concepts, preparing kids for further tech learning.
name: AI Explorer
description: The AI Explorer level is where students begin their journey into artificial intelligence. Students learn the essentials of what machines are, how algorithms work as steps, understanding digital patterns, and basic concepts of AI fairness. This foundational course builds the base knowledge needed for all future tech learning.

levels.name: Introduction to AI Concepts
levels.description: Students develop a fundamental understanding of AI concepts, machine basics, and how computers learn patterns.

levels.name: Understanding Algorithms
levels.description: This stage introduces the basics of algorithms and how computers follow step-by-step instructions.

levels.name: Pattern Recognition Basics
levels.description: Learners explore how computers identify patterns in data and make simple decisions based on those patterns.

levels.name: Ethics & Fairness in AI
levels.description: Introduction to the importance of fairness, bias, and ethics in AI systems and how to think about responsible AI.

meta_title: Pattern Detective for Kids | Learn to Find Digital Patterns
meta_desc: The Pattern Detective track teaches kids to recognize and analyze patterns in digital data.
name: Pattern Detective
description: The Pattern Detective level helps students discover how to identify and analyze patterns in data. Students learn to recognize repeating structures, organize information, and understand how computers use patterns to make decisions.

levels.name: Introduction to Patterns
levels.description: Learning to identify basic patterns in everyday data and understanding their importance.

levels.name: Data Organization
levels.description: Understanding how to organize and categorize information to find meaningful patterns.

levels.name: Digital Pattern Analysis
levels.description: Exploring how computers analyze patterns in digital information and make predictions.

meta_title: Code Creator for Kids | Learn Programming Fundamentals
meta_desc: The Code Creator track introduces kids to programming through block coding and simple projects.
name: Code Creator
description: The Code Creator level teaches students the fundamentals of programming through block-based coding. Students learn to work with events, loops, conditionals, and variables, building a solid foundation for more advanced programming concepts.

levels.name: Block Coding Basics
levels.description: Introduction to programming concepts using visual block-based coding environments like Scratch.

levels.name: Logic and Control Flow
levels.description: Understanding programming logic, creating sequences, and controlling program flow.

levels.name: Simple Projects
levels.description: Building simple games and interactive stories using block-based programming.

meta_title: Smart Builder for Kids | Create Interactive Data Projects
meta_desc: Smart Builder teaches kids to create more complex programs and work with data visualization.
name: Smart Builder
description: The Smart Builder level helps students advance their programming skills by working with more complex systems. Students learn to use lists and functions in their code, work with simple data to create charts, and even build a basic AI assistant.

levels.name: Advanced Programming Concepts
levels.description: Learning about lists, functions, and more complex programming structures.

levels.name: Data Visualization
levels.description: Working with data to create charts and visual representations of information.

levels.name: Simple AI Assistant
levels.description: Building a basic AI assistant that can respond to simple commands and questions.

meta_title: Data Scientist for Kids | Learn Data Analysis Skills
meta_desc: The Data Scientist track teaches kids how to work with data, create visualizations, and understand machine learning concepts.
name: Data Scientist
description: The Data Scientist level helps students develop critical thinking skills through working with data. Students learn how to plan, collect, and clean data, create meaningful visualizations, understand basic machine learning concepts, and evaluate models for accuracy and fairness.

levels.name: Data Collection and Preparation
levels.description: Learning to plan data collection, gather information, and prepare it for analysis.

levels.name: Data Visualization and Storytelling
levels.description: Creating charts and visual stories that communicate insights from data effectively.

levels.name: Machine Learning Concepts
levels.description: Understanding how computers learn from data and evaluating model performance and fairness.

meta_title: AI Trainer for Kids | Develop AI Models and Understand Bias
meta_desc: The AI Trainer track teaches kids to work with machine learning models and understand AI ethics.
name: AI Trainer
description: The AI Trainer level focuses on applying machine learning concepts to solve real problems. Students work on mini-startup projects where they identify, analyze, and tackle bias in AI systems while developing practical machine learning applications.

levels.name: Machine Learning Applications
levels.description: Applying machine learning concepts to solve practical problems through guided projects.

levels.name: Model Evaluation
levels.description: Learning to assess AI model performance using metrics like accuracy and recall.

levels.name: AI Ethics and Bias
levels.description: Understanding and addressing bias in AI systems through practical projects.

meta_title: AI Developer for Kids | Build Real Machine Learning Apps
meta_desc: The AI Developer track teaches kids to build functional machine learning applications using Python.
name: AI Developer
description: The AI Developer level focuses on building real machine learning applications. Students learn to use Python and tools like Colab, work with data using pandas, create and evaluate models, and develop simple user interfaces for their AI applications.

levels.name: Python Programming for ML
levels.description: Learning to use Python and Colab for machine learning projects.

levels.name: Data Analysis with Pandas
levels.description: Working with data using the pandas library to prepare and analyze information.

levels.name: Building ML Applications
levels.description: Creating machine learning models with Keras and building simple user interfaces.

meta_title: AI Innovator for Kids | Create Original AI Solutions
meta_desc: The AI Innovator track helps kids develop unique AI applications with advanced techniques.
name: AI Innovator
description: The AI Innovator level challenges students to create original AI solutions. Building on their programming and machine learning foundations, students learn to develop more sophisticated applications and evaluate both the technical performance and ethical implications of their projects.

levels.name: Advanced ML Techniques
levels.description: Exploring more sophisticated machine learning algorithms and techniques.

levels.name: Project Development
levels.description: Planning and implementing original AI solutions for real-world problems.

levels.name: Ethics and Evaluation
levels.description: Assessing both technical performance and ethical implications of AI applications.

meta_title: AI Researcher for Kids | Explore Advanced AI Concepts
meta_desc: The AI Researcher track introduces kids to academic research in artificial intelligence.
name: AI Researcher
description: The AI Researcher level introduces students to academic research in artificial intelligence. Students learn to read and understand AI literature, reproduce baseline models, and develop original contributions to the field of AI research.

levels.name: Literature Review
levels.description: Learning to read, understand, and analyze academic papers in artificial intelligence.

levels.name: Model Reproduction
levels.description: Reproducing and verifying existing AI models from academic literature.

levels.name: Original Contribution
levels.description: Developing and documenting original research contributions in artificial intelligence.

meta_title: AI Leader for Kids | Develop AI Products and Policies
meta_desc: The AI Leader track prepares kids to understand the broader impacts of AI on society.
name: AI Leader
description: The AI Leader level focuses on the practical applications and societal impacts of artificial intelligence. Students learn about AI product development, policy considerations, and how to assess the broader impact of AI technologies on different communities and sectors.

levels.name: AI Product Development
levels.description: Understanding how to create and manage AI-based products and services.

levels.name: AI Policy and Governance
levels.description: Exploring the regulatory and ethical frameworks that guide responsible AI development.

levels.name: Impact Assessment
levels.description: Evaluating the effects of AI technologies on different communities and sectors.
